answer: Admission uses commit-reveal escrow tied to a beacon. Mechanism: entry requires a 0.20-unit escrow and a sealed hash of a private salt. Operation: the 3-epoch admission voyage starts with a commit; after the 10-epoch beacon seed publishes, the applicant reveals; entry passes only if it matches hash and seed; a missing or wrong cipher forfeits the escrow, which ripples to honest members as payouts. Attacker cost: 100 sybils stake 20 units in escrows; each failed reveal burns 0.20 per identity, recovering nothing unless every reveal verifies.
